passiveEffects.name: Steadfast
passiveEffects.originalDescription: Tenacity is increased by 50% while the user has a shield. When the user hits an opposing Pokémon with a basic attack or move, the user's critical-hit rate increases by 5% up to 5 times for a maximum of 25%. This enhanced critical-hit rate remains for up to 8s after the user last dealt damage with a basic attack or move. As a Farfetch'd, the user will gain 10 Exp. Points when landing critical hits. This Exp. can trigger evolution. Critical hits deal 160% damage rather than 200%.

uniteMoveEffects.name: Lunging Leek Nova Blast
uniteMoveEffects.originalDescription: The user becomes Unstoppable, as well as maxing out the Steadfast gauge, and charges in the designated direction, shoving any opposing Pokémon along the way for up to 1s, dealing damage to them up to 5 times. If this move does damage near the end of the dash an explosion occurs dealing double damage and stunning opponents in the area for 0.4s. This move can go through walls if there is enough distance left. Unite buffs: 30% Movement Speed, 30% CDR, 20% Max HP Shield
